title: Refund Picker
summary: Shows the exact refund before it's issued: units per item, every deduction named, non-refundable items explained, and net amount per refund method.
description: Refund builder: pick units per item or a capped custom amount, see each restocking and return-shipping deduction, keep non-refundable items visible with the reason, compare each method's net and arrival dates, then read the whole refund back before issuing.
catches: Units per item, never more than were bought
A custom amount above what the picked items allow
Restocking and return-shipping deductions, each named
Non-refundable items, kept visible with the reason
Net amount and arrival window per refund method
limits: Arrival dates come from the ranges you pass; banks may take longer
Policy (fees, eligibility) is yours to supply; it does not know your return rules
Money is computed with JS numbers; round on the server
a11y: Section labelled by its title; each item's stepper is a labelled group with a polite <output>
Custom amount has a <label>, aria-invalid when over the cap, and a polite hint via aria-describedby
Refund methods are a labelled radiogroup of native radios
Confirm sets aria-busy while pending; icons are aria-hidden
server: Recompute the refundable amount from order data on the server, cap it, and make the refund request idempotent.
stops: Refund smaller than the customer expected
